reviews.text: dude it actually covers my brows. you don’t have to bleach/ dye your brows when u have this brow mascara. i got the shad beige ash and it’s kinda light for me but i’ll buy another one
reviews.zh: 真係，佢真係可以遮到眉毛。用咗呢款眉膏，就唔使漂眉或者染眉。我買咗 shad beige ash 色，對我嚟講有啲淺，不過我會再買多一支。

reviews.text:
I’ve been loving this brow product! It’s very easy to use and glides on smoothly. The formula lasts all day without smudging or fading, even in humid weather.

I have black hair, and shades 05 and 07 match me perfectly. The color doesn’t look too harsh or too light — it looks very natural. After using it, my face looks softer and more polished. It makes my overall look appear more gentle and effortless.
reviews.zh:
我一直好鍾意呢款眉部產品！好易用，推得好順滑。配方全日都唔會暈開或者脫色，即使天氣潮濕都得。

我係黑頭髮，05同07號色號好啱我。顏色唔會太突兀或者太淺，睇落好自然。用完之後，我個面睇落更柔和、更精緻。令我整體造型都顯得更溫柔、毫不費力。

reviews.text: I really like this contour stick! It has a nice cool tone that looks super natural on the skin—no orange or muddy finish. The formula is creamy and blends out effortlessly, whether with a brush or sponge. Just make sure to set it with a bit of powder afterward, because it can move around if you don’t. Overall, it’s a great, easy-to-use contour for a soft, sculpted look!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢枝修容棒！佢有好好嘅冷色調，搽喺皮膚上好自然，唔會有橙色或者污濁嘅感覺。質地幼滑、膏狀，無論用刷或者海綿都好容易推開。記得之後要用少少粉定妝，唔係佢會郁走。整體嚟講，係一款好易用、適合打造柔和立體效果嘅修容產品！

reviews.text: this brow mascara is honestly a game changer for me. my brows looked naturally full without needing to fill them in, and the shade matched my complexion and hair perfectly. super easy to use and gives such a clean, effortless look and they don’t even budge. definitely a must-have for everyone!
reviews.zh: 呢款眉睫膏真係為我帶嚟好大改變。唔使填眉，眉毛都已經自然咁豐盈，顏色同我嘅膚色同頭髮都好啱。好易用，效果乾淨、毫不費力，而且眉毛都唔會跑位。一定係人人必備！

reviews.text:
at first, it was hard for me to use it without touching the skin underneath the brow hairs and make it look so weird. You just have to apply it just above your skin to make sure the brow hairs are colored but not the skin! needs some precision!

I got Natural Brown as I have my hair dyed to ash brown-ish. That color suited my brows the best!
reviews.zh:
起初，我好難唔郁到眉毛下面嘅皮膚，搞到好怪。你要喺皮膚上面一點點咁畫，確保眉毛有色，但皮膚唔會有色！要有啲精準度！

我揀咗 Natural Brown，因為我頭髮染咗類似灰棕色嘅色。嗰個色最啱我嘅眉毛！

reviews.text: Recommend to people who want to lighten eyebrows without bleaching it. The color is what I've been looking for. Not yellow not brassy. Its a slightly cool toned ash taupe and the wand is so awesome it doesnt mess up my skin underneath the eyebrow hairs.
reviews.zh: 推薦畀想令眉毛淺色、但唔想漂色嘅人。呢個顏色正係我一直搵緊嘅。唔會發黃，亦唔會橙黃。係淡冷調嘅灰 taupe，而且個刷頭好好，唔會弄花眉毛下面嘅皮膚。

reviews.text: It applies to strongly and even if I do a light run through it smudges and causes my eyebrows to look like blocks
reviews.zh: 搽得太用力，就算我輕輕掃過一次都會暈開，令眉毛睇落一嚿嚿咁。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
